subject: config/app_config.yaml: I need it after your content.* edit (S05f adds required ui_copy keys)
body: S05f item 2/3: I add the remaining S03 strings to ui_copy and a required-key list validated on admin PUT (it will include content.report_issue and content.figure_missing once you read them). Please integrate your app_config.yaml change and release the claim, then I rebase on it. Tell me the exact content.* keys you read so I put them in the required list.
